items.text: In adults presenting to an emergency department with suspected myocardial infarction, what is the 30-day rate of death or myocardial infarction among patients ruled out by a one-hour high-sensitivity troponin pathway, and what proportion are ruled out, overall and in patients aged 75 or over or with kidney disease?
items.population: Adults with suspected myocardial infarction in emergency departments
items.outcome: 30-day death or myocardial infarction among ruled-out patients; proportion ruled out
items.setting: Emergency departments and chest pain units, with district hospitals reported separately

finer: Feasible in six weeks with ten librarian hours; interesting to the committee and both specialties; novel only in its focus on older and kidney patients in a district setting; ethical as a review of published data; relevant because a pathway change is scheduled for decision.
summary: One PICO question covering safety and yield, with age and kidney subgroups.
